description: libuvcpp on the libuv event loop, one loop per available core. Routing, path and query params, static files and WebSocket through uvcpp_web_app, nlohmann/json serialization behind uvcpp_json, gzip through the built-in response compression, and async Postgres through uvcpp_db_pool. HTTP/2 over TLS on 8443 and HTTP/3 on 8443/udp are the same build.
